quote: Supporting the system’s own regulatory processes doing what they do better, as opposed to trying to override them, is a key distinction in how we should approach the tech interface with the body.
author: Daniel Schmachtenberger

quote: One does not accumulate but eliminate. It is not daily increase but daily decrease. The height of cultivation always runs to simplicity.
author: Bruce Lee

quote: One of my favorite philosophical tenants is that people will agree with you only if they already agree with you. You do not change people's minds.
author: Frank Zappa
